subject.title: fix(kill-tree): verify process group leader before using group kill to prevent gateway SIGTERM (#76259)

question: Should OpenClaw accept the compatibility-sensitive Unix kill-tree behavior change after the dirty branch is rebased and current-main cleanup changes are preserved?
rationale: The code fix is coherent and proven, but it changes the default omitted-detached cleanup contract and the current branch cannot merge cleanly against newer process cleanup code.

options.title: Rebase and accept the helper-level fix
options.body: Preserve current-main NodeExecutionEnv cleanup changes, keep the leader-check approach, and require focused process cleanup plus smoke validation before merge.

options.title: Request a narrower caller-only fix
options.body: Keep omitted-detached group-kill semantics unchanged and require every risky caller to pass the exact detached fact instead.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Leave the canonical issue open and ask for an owner-authored replacement if maintainers are not ready to change the shared cleanup helper.

recommendation.title: Rebase and accept the helper-level fix
recommendation.body: Preserve current-main NodeExecutionEnv cleanup changes, keep the leader-check approach, and require focused process cleanup plus smoke validation before merge.
